user.title: EMS 2.0 – connect to server
user.description: House ID and token are in the EMS 2.0 portal (app.ems20.cz, Připojení / Connection page). Keep the server URL unless you run your own server.

inverter.title: Střídač SolaX
inverter.description: Dům: {site}. Prefix entit integrace SolaX Modbus (např. solax → sensor.solax_battery_capacity).

data.grid_invert: Obrátit znaménko výkonu sítě (když + znamená odběr)

house.title: Údaje o domu
house.description: Server zatím nezná baterii a panely. Azimut: 0 = jih, −90 = východ, 90 = západ. Vše jde později upravit na webu.

reauth_confirm.title: EMS 2.0 – nový token
reauth_confirm.description: Token domu {site} přestal platit. Vygeneruj na webu nový a vlož ho sem.

menu_options.generic: Jen data a doporučení – EMS nic neřídí, jakýkoli střídač

generic.title: Jen data a doporučení
generic.description: Dům: {site}. Vyber entity měření. Integrace je bude posílat na server a z plánu vytvoří senzory s doporučením (režim, levná/drahá elektřina, nejlevnější okna…) pro tvoje automatizace. Střídač neovládá.

data.load_w: Spotřeba domu (když chybí, server ji dopočítá)

error.unknown: Unexpected server error (house may not be approved yet).
error.entity_missing: Entita neexistuje – u SolaXu zkontroluj prefix (např. solax), jinak vyber SOC baterie.

init.title: EMS 2.0 – settings
init.description: Most homes need no changes here – EMS 2.0 reads SolaX Modbus by itself. Expand only what you need.

entities.name: Measurement entities
entities.description: Only when you use other entities than the SolaX Modbus defaults.

data.mode8_grid: Grid charging and selling via Mode 8/9 (experimental)

data_description.mode8_grid: Uses Mode 8/9 “Enabled Grid Control” instead of Mode 1. Recent SolaX firmware only.

t58.name: Battery cell monitor (Solax T58) – Premium
t58.description: Optional: all cell voltages, temperatures and balancing from the battery bus via an RS-485 → Ethernet converter. Read only. Stop the 'Solax T58 Battery Monitor' add-on.

data.t58_cells: Entity for every cell (otherwise module summaries only)

set_tariff.name: Nastavit tarif
set_tariff.description: Pošle tarif domu na server (nová verze).

tariff.name: Tarif
tariff.description: Tariff as an object, or a template (key template, e.g. cez_d57d_fix) with overrides.

replan.name: Přepočítat plán
replan.description: Požádá server o nový plán hned.

plan_appliance.name: Plan appliance
plan_appliance.description: Planned appliance (washer, dishwasher, wallbox…): EMS picks the cheapest time in the window together with the battery.

appliance.name: Appliance
appliance.description: Name or id of the appliance from EMS settings.

then.name: Then run
then.description: Another appliance after each run (e.g. dryer after washer).

kwh.name: Energy
kwh.description: Wallbox / energy kind only: kWh to deliver.

cancel_appliance.name: Cancel next appliance run
cancel_appliance.description: Cancels the next planned run that has not started.

job.name: Run
job.description: Id of a specific run to cancel (the card's ✕). Empty = the nearest run.

appliance_then.name: Run another appliance after
appliance_then.description: Adds a follow-up run (e.g. dryer after washer) to the running or next planned run, same window; empty = remove the follow-up.

then.name: Then run
then.description: Name or id of the follow-up appliance; empty or "nic" = remove.
